about: Maps left out of the menus on purpose (desktop and Android alike). Keys are level keys (jj2:<pack>:<number>) or a whole pack (jj2:<pack>:*); the value says why. Delete a line to bring a map back.

hidden.jj2:bl18:*: BL18 is built on JJ2+ scripts (drawn layers, textured backgrounds, scripted objects) this game can't run: Forlorn Planet Ex comes out as a jumble of tiles.
hidden.jj2:rob:8: The Zerox Factory: a front layer of black tiles hides the whole play field.

found.jj2:threed:0: Threed Realms: It needs JJ2+ scripts that draw and move its layers, which this game cannot run
